q: In the stochastic model of the Collatz map, consecutive bits of n are treated as i.i.d. Bernoulli(1/2). The expected multiplicative change per step is:
exp: Stochastic model: step halves n with prob 1/2 (factor 1/2), or applies (3n+1)/2 ≈ 3n/2 with prob 1/2. Expected factor = (1/2)(1/2) + (1/2)(3/2) = 1/4 + 3/4 = 1... but in log space: (1/2)log(1/2) + (1/2)log(3/2) = (1/2)log(3/4) < 0. Orbits shrink on average in log scale.
